readMe.a: Lead Field Health & Tech Debt Analysis — XBU

readMe.b: Identify which Lead fields are genuinely in use and which are tech debt, using measured record-level population rather than estimates.
Live Salesforce metadata (describe + Tooling API) read directly from XBU production (rainprod / Rain) on 2026-11-10.
Not required. Required? / Help Text / Description come from the same live describe + Tooling read.
Live SOQL aggregates against XBU production. All measures are exact counts over every Lead, not a sampled export, except the 17 Long Text Area fields which are sampled (200 records, last 365 days).
363 of 374 live Lead fields assessed. 10 field(s) excluded (not queryable via SOQL — platform-internal or orphaned metadata). 17 Long Text Area fields are listed on Not Assessable.
Flow/Layout/formula/other reference counts come from a fresh MetadataComponentDependency crawl of all 323 custom fields on 2026-11-10 (not carried forward from a prior snapshot).
Weights, thresholds and bands are carried over unchanged from the shared Case/Opportunity model so every object and business unit scores on the same scale.
